decisions.reason: The new copy mentions product media and links but does not change the required hero visual asset, layout, buttons, phone presentation, or visual purpose.
Replacing the text within the hero section does not change the landing page's overall content mix, specification source, or screenshot-selection rule.
The word email describes how sales pages may be shared and does not change contact-form submission delivery or recipients.
The source replaces hero copy without changing the approved visual style, design reference, or brand-colour source.
The hero copy replacement does not affect the Webflow platform or hosting-plan choice.
The new hero text neither introduces animation nor changes the animation-free presentation requirement.
The source is expressly limited to copy in the first hero section and does not change the bottom-of-page image.
The hero copy replacement does not mention or alter the dealer-login button or its top-right-only placement.
